duration.text: The Basic Mathematics at Anhui University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2000 USD/per year ￥ 14400 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Two Recommendation letters From Professors, associate professors or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1.To have received a college education or a similar education; 2.To submit his/her graduation certificate or a similar diploma and transcripts; 3.To submit 2 letters of recommendation from two professors or associate professors
